Players Committee card image of [[Yarna d'al' Gargan (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on table. While you have fewer than 13 cards in hand, non-unique aliens are immune to Monnok. Opponent may not increase deploy cost of your aliens. Once per turn, may deploy Arleil, Doallyn, Tessek, Wild Karrde, or a Tatooine battleground from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/yarnadalgargan.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018).
